synopsis: The booklet recommends a domain-neutral, version-controlled scenario catalog, using either Scenic or an in-house YAML schema with an OpenODD-style taxonomy [f7198, f14491]. The glossary adds that the catalog should be manufacturer-owned and exported to OpenSCENARIO when required by tools [f14491]. YAML, alongside JSON and XML, is suitable for structured settings, configuration files, scenario descriptions and small tables, but not gigabytes of sensor data [f13009]. YAML is therefore presented as a scenario-description option rather than a mandatory format or a bulk sensor-data format [f7198, f14491, f13009].

relations.note: Restates the catalog recommendation, adding manufacturer ownership and OpenSCENARIO export.
YAML's suitability for scenario descriptions supports its use for the scenario catalog.
